name: Herd
author: Carlos Granier
description: Live state of every herdr coding agent, on this machine and your saved remote machines, in the Omarchy bar.

barWidget.description: Working, blocked, and done counts for herdr agents across machines, with a panel to jump to any of them and a toast when one needs you.

schema.label: herdr binary
schema.description: Optional. Defaults to ~/.local/bin/herdr when present, otherwise the herdr on PATH.

schema.label: This machine
schema.description: Include agents from the local herdr server.

schema.label: Remote machines
schema.description: Comma-separated herdr machine labels. Leave empty for every enabled machine in `herdr machine list`; use `none` for local only.

schema.label: Remote refresh (seconds)
schema.description: How often remote machines are polled. Local changes arrive instantly over the herdr event socket.

schema.label: Notify when blocked
schema.description: Toast when an agent starts waiting on you. Click it to jump to the agent.

schema.label: Blocked breaks through Do Not Disturb
schema.description: Send blocked toasts as critical alerts so they show even while notifications are silenced. These toasts are not kept in notification history.

schema.label: Collapse idle agents
schema.description: Fold each machine's idle agents into one row. Agents that need you are always listed on top.
